book.name: Ioane
book.title: Ioane Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Ioaneꞌa Mirihiro

content: Mariaꞌa Iesu Oda rana Dehoro Hohoḡa Beuꞌoharo
Iḡine Modiroteꞌe Muiḡa veize mada fuꞌo tiba fare ꞌizema mougano, Iesuꞌa Betania neḡano feuriro. Aꞌe Iesuꞌa bare ḡaboniroteꞌe vazeḡa, Lazaroꞌa radiuꞌeteꞌe neḡa.
Eꞌanoꞌo eꞌea Iesu veize ḡorava ogomuḡa ruhibiro. Maretaꞌa ogomu haḡairo ebu Lazaroꞌe Iesu teite ogomu fataḡa babaḡano tave ehoriroteꞌe azaḡa boꞌaḡano radiro.

Ebu Mariaꞌa dehoro huga hohoḡa naeḡa boro, niḡa Nado bio komeꞌa iriꞌavonadu mae ariro. Ebu dehoro hohoḡa eꞌe Iesu oda rana beuꞌiro, ebu iguḡa hina zauhiro. Eꞌanoꞌo ne zamaḡanoꞌe dehoro hohoḡaniꞌa iriꞌaviro.
Rehano Iesu tahiꞌa ꞌahoga, vesuꞌu ani revohatiteꞌe tahiꞌaḡa ꞌahoga, Isakariota vazeḡa Iudaꞌa ꞌahige rae reiro,
“Dehoro hohoḡa ꞌadi seronadu muri tiba gau hadiḡa
hidifo ebu eꞌe hadiḡaꞌe zahara azaḡa zinifo.”
Aniꞌe mene zahara azaḡa zamariro, rehano aniꞌe ḡonore vazeḡa radu ꞌouge reiro. Aniꞌe zeḡe hadi fuseḡa taufeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa radu fuse zamaḡano ufiroteꞌe hadiḡa ane veize ḡonotaudo.
Ebu Iesuꞌa ꞌahige rae reiro, “Roḡae ꞌahiꞌe ago gararoꞌi, mazaḡa aniꞌe e rudanadu guriteꞌe madaḡa veize dehoro ꞌadi ruhibeha.
Zahara azaḡaꞌe iḡaiḡa zae teite radiꞌuma, u eꞌe iḡaiḡa zae teite mene radiꞌuma.”

Iuda azaḡa ḡuḡuvaḡaniꞌa Iesuꞌa Betania neḡano radiuꞌeteꞌe igirotene, eꞌe neḡa onamiro. Aꞌe mene Iesu daꞌo ḡianoga veize, rehano aneꞌa rune azaḡa boꞌaḡano bare ḡaboniroteꞌe vazeḡa Lazaro zuni ḡianoga veize reiro.
Eꞌanoꞌo dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaḡihiꞌaḡaꞌe Lazaro zuni matihi rae ḡoꞌaniro,
mazaḡa Lazaro uꞌano, Iuda azaḡa ḡehaḡaniꞌa ze modadu Iesu vaḡe onamiro ebu ani mazao firo.
Ierusalema Diuḡiro
Irarirotene, Iḡine Modiroteꞌe Muiḡa veize Ierusalema itiroteꞌe vaze ḡuḡuvaḡaniꞌa Iesuꞌe Ierusalema aroga igiro.
Eꞌanoꞌo ze Sigi rouga
variꞌe madu ani hidoga veize onamiro. Ebu ze ḡihau huaro,

content.text: Zuhiꞌa Boro niḡano areꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe ḡihiꞌa hune!

content: Iesuꞌa doniki ubuga horonadu eꞌe rana tire ehoriro. Buka Zaḡoḡano ꞌahige rae mirihiro,

content.text: Ḡianoꞌi, zae kiniꞌa doniki ubuga rana ehoradu areꞌohe.”

content: Eꞌe madaḡano Iesu tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌe ꞌahiguḡa mene faine zamariro. Rehano Iesuꞌa runeonoꞌo bare ḡabodiroteꞌe enogano, Buka Zaḡoḡano ani moneo ꞌahiguḡa mirihiroteꞌe zu vazevazeꞌa ani mazao ꞌouge haḡairotaꞌaꞌe ederiro.
Ebu Iesuꞌa iduonoꞌo Lazaro hunadu rune azaḡa boꞌaḡano bare ḡaboniroteꞌe madaḡano, ani teite radiroteꞌe vaze ḡuḡuvaḡaniꞌa eꞌe hariḡa vaze mazao barebare rae fureniro.
Ebu vaze ḡehaḡaniꞌa Iesuꞌa haḡai nu badeḡa ꞌadi haḡairoteꞌe igiro ꞌahine, ze ani hidoga radu ane vaḡe onamiro.
Eꞌanoꞌo Farisea azaḡaꞌe zeḡeꞌa bare neneḡaniro, “Ḡianoꞌi. ꞌAhiꞌe mene emeꞌa haḡaihi reiroteꞌe haḡaiḡa. Raha azaḡa niduꞌa ani hegote onamiro!”
Iesuꞌa Ane Rune moneo rae Fureniro
Iḡine Modiroteꞌe Muiḡano Badiꞌa mazao kuranoga veize Ierusalema onamiroteꞌe azaḡa boꞌaḡano Giriki azaḡa nuꞌa radiunu.
Giriki azaḡa eꞌeꞌa Galilea habaꞌa Betesaida vazeḡa Filipi vaḡe onamadu uminiro, “Vaze boro, emeꞌe Iesu ḡianihi raꞌohe.”
Ebu Filipiꞌa onamadu Anderea niro, ebu anianine Iesu vaḡe onamadu ḡadiniro.
Ebu Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “Badiꞌaꞌa Vaze Ubugaꞌe ḡihiꞌa hune rae ihoziteꞌe madaḡaꞌe maha.
Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe. Vuidi maḡa rahao mene gurine, aniꞌe maḡa isoḡa radiꞌuma. Rehano ani rahao gurine, ḡehaḡaniꞌa hudaꞌuma.
Iniuꞌa ane ḡabone zamare borofine, ḡabone tuḡutuḡu mene hidiꞌuma. Rehano iniuꞌa raha ꞌada ane ḡabone heꞌeheꞌenine, ḡabode radiꞌuma onamo radiu tuḡutuḡu.
Iniuꞌa eḡe tuḡure vazeḡa reihi roꞌidene, eḡe hegotoꞌi. Eꞌe noꞌe habaꞌano radiune, eḡe tuḡure vazeḡa zuni eꞌea radiꞌuma. Eḡe tuḡure vazeḡaꞌe eḡe Mamaꞌa niguniꞌuma.
Izidi eḡe zamaꞌe aduduꞌohe. E nagini reꞌuma? 'Mama, aduga madaḡa ꞌahaonoꞌo e ḡabohoꞌi,' rae reꞌuma ga? Mene, e aduga madaḡa ꞌahi mouga veize ariro.
Mama, ḡae ni mae ḡihinoꞌi!” ꞌOugadu ago ꞌahoganiꞌa adureonoꞌo ꞌahige rae reiro, “Eḡeꞌa nihe mae ḡihineha zu bare mae ḡihiniꞌuma.”
Vaze ḡuḡuvaḡa eꞌea ḡoere eꞌe egadu, “Viriꞌa fuꞌureꞌohe,” rae reiro. Ebu nuꞌe, “Tuḡure viganiꞌa ani mazao ḡoereha,” rae reiro.
Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “Ago aꞌe mene eḡe veize, rehano zae veize ḡoereha.
Izidiꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa raha ꞌadi azaḡa kotazeꞌeteꞌe madaḡa. Izidiꞌe raha ꞌadi zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa, Satani mae vaḡiniꞌuma.
Rehano vazeꞌa rahaonoꞌo eḡe mae ḡihihine, eḡeꞌa vaze niduꞌa eḡe vaḡe hutube ariꞌuma.”
Iesuꞌe aneꞌa nougenouge rudatiteꞌe moneo ihozifine ꞌouge rae reiro.
Ebu vaze ḡuḡuvaḡaniꞌa niro, “Buka Zaḡoḡanonoꞌo
eme ꞌahige edereꞌohe, 'Kerisoꞌe radiu tuḡutuḡu.' Rehano ḡaꞌe nougadu, 'Vaze Ubugaꞌe rahaonoꞌo mae ḡihiniꞌuma,' rae raꞌohe? Vaze Ubugaꞌe iniu?”

Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “Agaḡaꞌe mada tahiḡa bare zae teite radiꞌuma. Agaḡaꞌe zae teite radiuꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano oname onaoꞌi, ꞌougine zaꞌe uzaboꞌa mene ḡahiziꞌuma. Uzabo zamaḡano ragaveꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe ani noꞌe onameꞌetaꞌaꞌe aḡuꞌa.
Agaḡaꞌe zae teite radiuꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano agaḡa mazao fioꞌi, ꞌougine za agaḡa ubuga reꞌuma.” Iesuꞌa ꞌouge ziroteꞌe enogano, muhize onamadu zeḡe mazaonoꞌo uꞌuraro.
Iesu mazao Mene Fieꞌeteꞌe Azaḡa
Iesuꞌa haḡai nu badeḡa ḡehaḡa vaze zamao haḡairo, rehano ze ꞌize ani mazao mene firo.
Peroveta vazeḡa Isaiaꞌa reiroteꞌe ḡoeꞌaniꞌa hudaro,

content.text: “Zuhiꞌa Boro, emeḡeꞌa haramiroteꞌe ḡoeꞌaꞌe vazeꞌa mene mae ḡihiniro.
Ḡaeꞌa gigiꞌaḡo ze ihoziro, rehano ze mene mae ḡihiniro.”

content: Nougadu ze Iesu mazao fioga mene idararoteꞌe moneo Isaiaꞌa ꞌahige bare rae reiro,

content.text: Eꞌe uꞌano, ze ubumaze hina horoneꞌe rehano, hugaꞌe mene horoniꞌuma,
zu zamaze hina mene faine zamariꞌuma.
Aꞌe, ze eḡe vaḡe ḡihure baradu mene manoroga veize raꞌohe.”

content: Isaiaꞌa ꞌahige rae reirotaꞌaꞌe mazaḡa ani Iesuꞌe ḡihiꞌa hune rae ederiro zu ani moneo ḡoeriro.
U vaze ibitoziꞌeteꞌe azaḡa boꞌaḡano vaze ḡehaḡaniꞌa Iesu mazao firo. Rehano ze ani mazao fieꞌetaꞌaꞌe vaze ꞌahoga mene niro, mazaḡa Farisea azaḡaniꞌa nu'onu'o neḡanonoꞌo ze mae buziꞌuma radu riharo.
Ze vazeꞌa ze niguzeꞌetaꞌaꞌe ufeta zamariro, rehano Badiꞌaꞌa ze niguzeꞌetaꞌaꞌe mene zamariro.
Ebu Iesuꞌa agoḡa boro hina ḡihau ḡoeriro, “Iniu eḡe mazao fieꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe eḡe mazao daꞌo mene fieꞌohe, rehano eḡe tuḡuhiroteꞌe vazeḡa mazao fieꞌohe.
Ebu iniu eḡe ḡiaheꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe eḡe tuḡuhiroteꞌe vazeḡa ḡianeꞌohe.
Agaḡa teige, e raha ꞌahi ariro. Aꞌe eḡe mazao fieꞌeteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌaꞌe uzabo zamaḡano mene radoga veize raꞌohe.
Iniu eḡe ḡoere egadu mene hegotine zuni, e ani mene kotaniꞌuma. Mazaḡa eꞌe raha azaḡa kotazoga veize mene ariro, rehano ḡabozoga veize ariro.
Eḡe hezahohiꞌeteꞌe zu eḡe ḡoere mene mae ḡihineꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa kotaneꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe ꞌahoga. Mada ḡonagano eḡeꞌa rateꞌe ḡoeꞌa ꞌadi hina ani kotaniꞌuma.
E eḡe edeḡano mene ḡoeriro, rehano eḡe tuḡuhiroteꞌe Mamaheꞌa e nagini rouga zu nouge rae rouga ihohiro.
E edeḡa, ani goro ḡoeꞌaniꞌa ḡabone tuḡutuḡu ibiḡano ibitoziꞌohe. Eꞌanoꞌo e Mamaꞌa nagini ihiroteꞌe ḡoeꞌa daꞌo raꞌohe.”
